wikipedia_page.name: wikipedia_page
wikipedia_page.type: varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

item_key.name: item_key
item_key.type: varchar(700) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

thread_key.name: thread_key
thread_key.type: varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

matches_result_only_when_played.name: matches_result_only_when_played
matches_result_only_when_played.value: (`matches`.`status` = 'played' and `matches`.`goals_for` is not null and `matches`.`goals_against` is not null) or (`matches`.`status` <> 'played' and `matches`.`goals_for` is null and `matches`.`goals_against` is null)

matches_time_or_text.name: matches_time_or_text
matches_time_or_text.value: `matches`.`kickoff_at` is not null or `matches`.`date_text` is not null

matches_extra_time_only_in_played_knocko.name: matches_extra_time_only_in_played_knockout
matches_extra_time_only_in_played_knocko.value: `matches`.`extra_time` = 0 or (`matches`.`status` = 'played' and `matches`.`competition` in ('KNVB Beker', 'Play-offs Conference League'))

matches_penalties_in_a_pair.name: matches_penalties_in_a_pair
matches_penalties_in_a_pair.value: (`matches`.`penalties_for` is null and `matches`.`penalties_against` is null) or (`matches`.`penalties_for` is not null and `matches`.`penalties_against` is not null)

matches_after_ninety_in_a_pair.name: matches_after_ninety_in_a_pair
matches_after_ninety_in_a_pair.value: (`matches`.`after_ninety_for` is null and `matches`.`after_ninety_against` is null) or (`matches`.`after_ninety_for` is not null and `matches`.`after_ninety_against` is not null)

staff_start_date_fits_precision.name: staff_start_date_fits_precision
staff_start_date_fits_precision.value: (`staff`.`start_precision` = 'day') or (`staff`.`start_precision` = 'month' and dayofmonth(`staff`.`start_date`) = 1) or (`staff`.`start_precision` = 'year' and dayofyear(`staff`.`start_date`) = 1)

staff_end_date_fits_precision.name: staff_end_date_fits_precision
staff_end_date_fits_precision.value: `staff`.`end_date` is null or (`staff`.`end_precision` = 'day') or (`staff`.`end_precision` = 'month' and dayofmonth(`staff`.`end_date`) = 1) or (`staff`.`end_precision` = 'year' and dayofyear(`staff`.`end_date`) = 1)
